title: Art & Criticism: Consolidation
goal: Combine aesthetic judgements, curatorial state passives, critical superlatives, manner clauses, and impersonal se across art criticism.
grammar: review of resultar patterns, estar vs ser + participle, critical superlatives, manner clauses, and impersonal se

items: I can combine resultar evaluations, estar + participle descriptions, and critical superlatives in art criticism.
I can analyse artistic technique with tal como, según + subjunctive, and el modo en que.
I can maintain an impersonal critical gaze with singular se before human a-objects.
